summary: Customers in Flagstaff searching for a plumber are finding three competitors before they find you. Your website works, but Google can't tell which services you offer or where, and your Google Business Profile has a fraction of the reviews the top listings have. The good news: every one of these is fixable, and two of them take less than a week.

top_fixes.title: Give each service its own page
top_fixes.why: Right now "water heater repair", "drain cleaning" and "emergency plumber" all point to your homepage. Google ranks pages, not businesses, so each search needs a page built for it.

top_fixes.title: Close the review gap
top_fixes.why: The top 3 plumbers in the map results average 180 reviews. You have 14. A simple text-after-every-job request closes this in a few months.

top_fixes.title: Fix your page titles
top_fixes.why: Your homepage title is just "Home". Google shows this in search results, so it tells nobody what you do or where.

checks.detail: Homepage title is "Home". 4 of 6 pages share the same title.
Missing on 5 of 6 pages, so Google writes its own.
Homepage H1 is "Welcome!" instead of what you do and where.
No LocalBusiness schema, so Google has to guess your address and hours.
Phone number is tappable on mobile.
Hero image is 4.2 MB, the main reason the site is slow on phones.

gbp.detail: None set. Add Water heater installation service, Drainage service.
14 reviews vs. 180 average for the top 3.
No posts in the last 90 days.
3 services listed; you offer at least 8.

opportunities.note: Weak competition: the top results are national directories, not local plumbers.
You already serve Sedona but have no page for it.
Higher-ticket jobs, almost no local content written about it.

plan.what: Fix page titles, descriptions and headings. Add local business markup. Compress images. Fill out every Google Business Profile field.
Build a page for each core service and each nearby town. Start a review request after every job.
Publish helpful articles around the questions customers ask. Post on your Google profile weekly. Track rankings every week.
